hints.title: Check Feasibility Bounds
hints.text: Each array of length n has achievable sum between n and 6 * n; if intervals do not overlap, equality is impossible.

hints.title: Evaluate Maximum Reduction Contributions
hints.text: To reduce sum difference, elements in larger array can decrease by x - 1, and elements in smaller array can increase by 6 - x.

hints.title: Greedy Highest Gain Selection
hints.text: Bucket potential improvements from 5 down to 1 and greedily take the largest available gains until difference is zero.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Knapsack dynamic programming is too slow when sums reach 6 * 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bucket counting of gains from 1 to 5 allows linear O(n + m) greedy reduction in O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate sorts or buckets differences (gain from 1 to 5) to minimize operation count greedily.
